I have cared for these fruit trees on my small plot for many years, and I know they grow well with the cow manure and compost I spread around their roots each season. Chemical fertilizer and pesticides are too costly for me, and at my age I prefer the traditional ways my mother taught me. My children and grandchildren will help me with weeding and harvesting when they have time from their own work, so I do not need to hire anyone from outside.
